within_model_pairs.fraction_definition: Mean of per-catalog matched/count and unmatched/count across the two catalogs in each pair; empty catalogs are omitted from these fractions.

primary_outcome.difference_direction: Terra minus Luna; positive favors higher observed semantic repeatability for Terra under this proxy.
primary_outcome.jackknife_method: Delete one run at a time within each cohort; recompute the mean of all remaining unordered run-pair semantic Jaccards. For the difference of independently collected cohorts, combine cohort jackknife variances as sqrt(SE_Terra^2 + SE_Luna^2).
primary_outcome.assumptions_and_limitations: Approximate interval assumes exchangeable independent runs within each cohort and independent cohorts. Runs were sequential, so service/time dependence can violate this assumption; treat the interval as exploratory. Pairwise values are not treated as independent observations.

count_context.note: Jaccard reflects both item identity and catalog size; count mean, sample SD, and range are reported alongside it to distinguish output volume from repeatability.

primary_outcome.accuracy_note: No ground-truth labeling was used; this analysis does not measure factual accuracy.

luna_joint_embedding_vs_original_analysi.interpretation: Primary model comparison uses the jointly embedded Luna baseline because every Luna and Terra text was embedded together in one fresh pass. Differences from the prior Luna report reflect a separate post-hoc embedding pass and are disclosed here.

comparison.semantic_method: cosine >= threshold; deterministic maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching with augmenting paths; ties follow catalog order, then descending cosine and right index
comparison.semantic_caveat: Semantic matches are embedding-based repeatability proxies, not verified factual equivalence.
comparison.exact_method: literal raw info string equality, multiset counts, with one-to-one occurrence matching
comparison.within_pair_design: all unordered pairs within each 100-run cohort
comparison.cross_pair_design: full Cartesian product of 100 Luna and 100 Terra catalogs; no run-ID pairing
comparison.inference_note: Pairwise catalogs are dependent and are not treated as independent observations. The primary interval uses a leave-one-run-out jackknife over within-cohort U-statistics and assumes exchangeable independent sequential runs; it is approximate and exploratory. No accuracy or causal model effect is measured.

cross_model_pairs.fraction_definition: Mean of per-catalog matched/count and unmatched/count across the two catalogs in each pair; empty catalogs are omitted from these fractions.
